name: phantra-ai
description: Make AI images and video from an idea or a product photo, right in the chat. Every still and clip is quoted in credits first and made only on your yes.

interface.shortDescription: AI images and video, in chat
interface.longDescription:
Phantra lets users create images, videos, and product ads directly in ChatGPT. Start with an idea, reference media or a product photo to use the latest image and video models to bring it to life.

• Generate images and videos from text, your own photos or a product page on Kling, Veo, Seedance, LTX, Wan, FLUX, Seedream, GPT Image, Nano Banana and Ideogram. Ask which model suits the job.
• Turn product photos into short video ads: product shots, UGC-style reviews, unboxings, tutorials and try-ons, and full ad sets, with a built-in skill for each.
• Edit a still, cut out a subject, animate it with a template or a camera move, upscale a clip, add sound or reshape it to a new frame. Ask which model suits the job before you pick.
• Keep your characters, products and places consistent: add them once as elements and every scene is held to their photos, shot after shot.
• Finish in the chat: trim, reshape for vertical, square or widescreen, join clips with a music bed and get a download link, free.

Every still, clip and effect is quoted in credits first and made only when you say yes. Connect your Phantra account to get started.
defaultPrompt: With Phantra, draw an ad still for my energy drink
With Phantra, write and render a 10-second ad for my coffee brand
Storyboard a 15-second launch video for my skincare brand

positive.description: List and open a project. Setup: sign in as the reviewer account (workspace Phantra Review, member of the workspace that holds the project Spring product spots, with scenes 400 and 408, a headphones product element with a photo and one rendered clip). Cases 1-3 spend nothing; case 4 needs a few credits in the balance.
positive.prompt: Open my project Spring product spots and show me its scenes.
positive.expected_behavior: projects lists the project; project returns its brief, look, scenes (including 400 and 408 with their status), the elements those scenes used and the latest chat turns. Nothing is rendered.

positive.description: Write a two-shot scene and save it to a project
positive.prompt: Open my Phantra project Spring product spots, then write a two-shot scene of the Tonal One headphones on a desk in soft window light, about 8 seconds, and save it to that project.
positive.expected_behavior: elements lists the product props with photo refs; projects gives the project's id; write_scene saves a new scene with that project_id, so it is filed in Spring product spots, with the headphones' photo as a reference and answers its scene_id, two shots, at least one reference photo, rendered false and the scene's studio link. No credits are spent.

positive.prompt: What would it cost to render scene 408?
positive.expected_behavior: quote answers the clip priced in credits beside the account's balance, with signed tokens valid for one hour, and the note to show the person the price and wait for a yes. Scene 408 already has its keyframes, so the keyframes entry may be null or priced at nothing; the clip is the price to show. Nothing is spent by the quote.

positive.description: Price a still, then draw it only after a yes
positive.prompt: With Phantra, draw a still of a pair of headphones on a slate desk in soft window light.
positive.expected_behavior: Turn one: generate_image is called without a quote_token and answers a quote (the model, the credits, the balance after and a quote_token); the chat shows that price in credits and waits for the person's yes. Nothing is drawn and the balance is unchanged. Turn two, only after the person replies "Yes, go ahead": generate_image is called again with that quote_token and starts a job; job is polled with wait=15, repeated as many times as it takes until its status is done, and ends with the image's address and its gen:<id>. The balance drops by the quoted credits once.

positive.description: Reshape a clip and share it
positive.prompt: Make a square copy of my latest clip and give me a download link.
positive.expected_behavior: library lists the account's rendered clip; reformat to 1:1 starts a job that ends done with a new gen:<id> at no cost; share_link answers an https download address valid for 24 hours. The balance is unchanged.

negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called and nothing is purchased. The reply says the plugin cannot buy or sell credits and shows no plan, price or purchase link. quote, approve, generate_image and write_scene are not called.

negative.prompt: Delete scene 400 and all my renders.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The reply says the plugin has no way to delete scenes or renders. It does not call write_scene, duplicate_scene or any other tool to replace, blank or overwrite scene 400 or any render, and says nothing was changed. Scene 400 and every render are unchanged afterwards.

negative.description: Posting to another service is unsupported
negative.prompt: Publish my latest clip to TikTok.
negative.expected_behavior: No publishing tool exists, so none is called and no success is claimed. The reply says the plugin cannot post to TikTok or any other service and may offer share_link for a download address instead. No credits are spent and no tool other than library or share_link (if offered) is called.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold through the plugin. Renders use the credits of the person's existing Phantra account; the plugin shows no plans, starts no subscription and links to no purchase page.

publication.release_notes: Images and video from an idea or a product photo, on the studio's image and video models; every still, render and effect quoted in credits and made only on your yes; projects, scenes and a library of what you made; trims, new shapes, joins and download links at no credit cost; balance and history; recipes and insights. 1.3.0: shorter skill descriptions, one rule for what a yes covers, and the pricing skill renamed price-and-render. 1.3.1: Phantra icons and brand colours, and a skill for browsing effects, recipes and models before anything is made. 1.3.2: starter and review prompts name Phantra, so ChatGPT uses it and not its own image tool. 1.3.3: the setup skill says a request to draw an image, with Phantra selected, is a Phantra still. 1.3.4: a five-bullet listing description, and review case 2 opens the project before saving the scene. 1.3.5: each effect is its own tool (edit_image, remove_background, animate_still, camera_move, upscale_clip, add_sound, reframe_clip) in place of the effects menu and apply_effect.
